description: Register up to 20 available domains with ONE payment (exact total in the 402). Returns a price-locked quote, checkout_url for a human to pay, and is idempotent via idempotency_key. After payment each is registered; any failure is refunded to prepaid balance.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT)

ref.description: Affiliate ref code. Earn $0.60 per .com you refer, $0.51 per .xyz, paid weekly in USDC.
